title: `NodePath` incorrectly updates property path when moving nodes around the scene
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.1 stable, 4.7.2 rc1, 4.8 dev3 (all versions are not mono)
- Differently reproducible in: 4.6.3 stable

### System information

Godot Engine v4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.318 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR)

### Issue description

Visuals are worth 1000 words, i'll explain under the video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3fa04a31-8f7f-4c1b-baa9-719967446341

I have this addon: https://github.com/tomsterBG/short

It has a system where i can define an `Array[PropertyBinding]` where `PropertyBinding` is a resource with `NodePath` properties. For some reason however, when i move the `Node` this `Array[PropertyBinding]` is a member of, every `PropertyBinding`'s `NodePath` breaks while trying to update.

Said breakage is observed by adding a useless duplication of the property part of the `NodePath`, aka the part after the `:` (colon).

Unfortunately i could not get it to reproduce on 4.7.1 in my MRP, but in 4.6.3 in the MRP i managed to get a whole different bug that is still related.

Moving the nodes around was completely stripping out the property part of the `NodePath`. This seems fixed in 4.7.1.

### Steps to reproduce

**From Short or a custom project:**
- Open a new project and put Short (https://github.com/tomsterBG/short) in addons or just clone it and open it (i have not published it to the Asset Store yet).
- Make a scene and add a `Node` with `Array[BindProperties]`, such classes are: `ShortHSlider`, `ShortVSlider`, `ShortCheckBox`, `ShortButton` or `ShortOptionButton`.
- Enable `BindProperties` and add a new `PropertyBinding`.
- Set any `NodePath` (`path_a` or `path_b`) to point to another node in the scene, but also point to a property inside it.
- Move your nodes around the scene tree hierarcy to force `NodePath` updates.
- Observe broken `NodePath`.
(yeah i think the video above shows all this without saying a word, it's worth all these words)
**From the MRP:**
- Open project.
- Run and observe how the slider works.
- Move the nodes around the scene tree in the mentioned Godot versions.
- Run and observe how the slider does not work. Also observe how the slider's `PropertyBinding.path_b` changes incorrectly.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[NodePath incorrectly updating properties.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31119019/NodePath.incorrectly.updating.properties.zip)
